goal.text: Finish tidying the house room by room and confirm nothing has been left half-done

turns.text: Am I still on the kitchen floor, or moved on?

trigger.detail: gaze lifts off the patch being swept and lands on the stairs

expected_answer.text: You're still in the kitchen, sweeping the floor with the broom in both hands and working your way to the right.

turns.text: I picked something up mid-sweep — which hand?

trigger.detail: the dustpan is lifted off the chair and the sweeping stroke ends

expected_answer.text: Your left hand. You kept the broom in your right and took the dustpan off the chair with your left.

turns.text: actually — going round in circles, or one direction?

trigger.detail: a second bend-and-sweep cycle begins and the user loses track of progress

expected_answer.text: One direction. You swept rightward across the kitchen, then carried the pile out into the hallway, so nothing has been redone.

turns.text: mm-hm... mm — sorry, where am I taking it to empty?

trigger.detail: the user breaks a backchannel into a question about the next step

expected_answer.text: To the pedal bin at the edge of the dining area. You step the pedal with your left foot and tip the pan in.

turns.text: So where are those two going now?

trigger.detail: the bin lid drops and the walk back down the hallway finishes at the closet

expected_answer.text: Into the hallway closet. You clipped the pan onto the broom handle first, then slid the set in with your right hand and shut the door.

turns.text: hang on — did the stairs come into view just then, or am I imagining that?

trigger.detail: the stairs leave frame for the last time as the user turns away from the closet

expected_answer.text: Yes, briefly. The stairs edged into frame for about half a second as you turned away from the closet, then dropped out again.

turns.text: That thing I lifted off the piano — what, and where now?

trigger.detail: the item carried from the piano is set down and the hand comes away empty

expected_answer.text: A stuffed toy. You picked it up with your left hand and set it down on the fireplace hearth, one step to your left.

turns.text: I've picked up something else already. What is it this time?

trigger.detail: a key is pressed on the piano and both hands close around a new object

expected_answer.text: A book. You pressed a key on the piano first, then picked the book up and folded it shut in both hands.

turns.text: Right, that can just live on the lid for now.

trigger.detail: a lull after the lid is closed

expected_answer.text: Sure. It's open on the piano now, next to the lid you closed a moment ago.

turns.text: What did I just shove under there?

trigger.detail: the chair is tucked in and a low object is pushed out of the walkway

expected_answer.text: The bathroom scale. It was sitting out on the floor and you slid it under the hearth with your left hand.

turns.text: Okay, good. I'll get the cushions sorted and then we're done.

trigger.detail: the user talks over the reply to announce the last job

expected_answer.text: Sounds good. The couch and both chairs still have cushions sitting at odd angles.

turns.text: So that's the whole downstairs done — anything still out of place?

trigger.detail: the last seat is straightened and the user stops moving

expected_answer.text: Yes, you're done. You plumped and reset the sofa cushions one by one, and the last one went back on the couch just now.
